scientific_conclusions: The new body S-curve at the unchanged commanded 0.015 m ZMP acceleration budget is feasible on all six frozen nominal development cases and the selected two safe-cancellation cases. This is limited simulation evidence, not hardware, terrain, GUI or general robustness qualification.

Alpha 1.0 is the strongest eligible tested fixed setting in both directions at 9.37 s per commanded 30 mm cycle. It shortens time by 3.30% left and 3.50% right relative to the strong old fixed baseline, below the frozen 5% threshold. It shortens time by 11.18% relative to zero, which does not rescue the combined engineering gate.
Only 0.03–0.04 s is gained from alpha .925 to 1.0. The saturation is observed; its cause is not established by this qualification report.
No new lateral actor, value or optimizer was executed. C33 cannot demonstrate RL speed improvement. Commanded 30 mm / 9.37 s is about 0.00320 m/s and remains far from fluid A/D operation.
Torque-normalized squared mean is the frozen effort proxy; it is not mechanical or electrical energy.
